name: Bassett Furniture
old_description: Every dream begins with a vision. At your local Bassett Furniture get inspired by our selection of bedroom, dining room, living room, and outdoor furniture, plus the finishing touches like lamps, rugs and window treatments. You can also explore our American BenchMade Collections. Made in small towns from Virginia to North Carolina, BenchMade features the highest standards for materials and quality, crafted by our skilled artisans.
about:
Bassett Furniture operates a retail location at 1250 Eagle Road in Meridian, Idaho, serving as a showroom for the company's broader manufacturing operations. The brand's BenchMade wood collections are produced in a factory in Virginia, while upholstered pieces are assembled in Newton, North Carolina, using both domestic and imported components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available store information.

The company manufactures bedroom, dining room, living room, and outdoor furniture, offering customization on finishes, fabrics, sizing, and configurations through its BenchMade and upholstery lines. A design studio at the Meridian store provides access to over 600 fabric and leather options along with wood finish samples. Manufacturing processes include wood milling and upholstery assembly, though specific equipment and production volumes are not published.

Bassett Furniture primarily serves residential customers and interior designers seeking furnished home solutions. The Meridian store carries representative pieces from the catalog and offers complimentary design consultation, in-home space planning, and virtual appointments. Commercial or contract sales are not mentioned in the store materials.

The company emphasizes its BenchMade collections as a differentiator, highlighting skilled artisans and high material standards. White-glove delivery includes assembly and packaging removal, and a Guardian Signature Plus protection plan covers stains and accidental damage. These service elements are presented as part of the brand's quality commitment.
